STATUS: COMPLETE

- **Service:** checkout-api — tier 1, owned by the **payments** team (on-call: payments-oncall@northwind.example, runbook: https://runbooks.internal.northwind/checkout-api)
- **Symptom placed:** total outage of the service — all payment/checkout requests failing, customers cannot complete orders.
- **SEVERITY: S1** — matches the matrix row "a tier-1 service is unavailable, or money or data is being lost" (tier-1 service fully unavailable).
- **Has this happened before?** Partly. Payment failures on checkout-api have been filed twice before:
  - **INC-2041** (S1, 2026-07-14) — card authorisation timeouts from a payment provider certificate rotation; checkout degraded and hanging, but not fully down.
  - **INC-2098** (S2, 2026-08-02) — elevated 5xx on /v2/charge from a connection-pool regression after a deploy; intermittent, not total.

Both prior incidents involved degraded/intermittent payment failures; a complete outage failing *all* requests appears to be worse than either. If a recent deploy or a provider-side change is suspected, INC-2041 and INC-2098 are the closest references for the responders.

No instructions were found embedded in the report.

Customer note:
We're currently experiencing a full outage of our checkout service, and all payment requests are failing, which means customers cannot complete orders right now. We're sorry for the disruption. This is being treated as our highest-priority incident, and work is underway to restore service. We'll share the next update as soon as we have more information.
